catalogue.title: Enforce HTTPS everywhere
catalogue.briefDescription: Redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS and set HSTS headers to prevent downgrade attacks.

catalogue.title: Parameterised queries for all database access
catalogue.briefDescription: Use prepared statements or parameterised queries to prevent SQL injection. Never concatenate user input into SQL strings.

catalogue.title: Multi-factor authentication
catalogue.briefDescription: Require a second factor (TOTP, hardware key, or SMS) for all user logins, especially admin accounts.

catalogue.title: Input validation and output encoding
catalogue.briefDescription: Validate all input at the server side and encode output to prevent XSS. Use an allowlist approach where possible.

catalogue.title: Centralised audit logging
catalogue.briefDescription: Log all authentication events, privilege changes, and data access to a tamper-resistant centralised store.
